Backups are now `.bak` files, and the backup password is your choice.

### What's changed
- **Backups are `.bak` files.** A backup is still one file holding everything (people, photos, templates, settings, users and history), and it can be restored on any PC with this program. Automatic backups use `.bak` too. Backups made before this version end in `.idcbak` and still restore as before.
- **A backup password is optional.** **Download backup** now has **Protect the backup with a password**, ticked to start. With a password, the backup can't be restored or read without it. Without one, anyone with this program and the file can restore it.
- **Restore asks for a password only when the backup has one.**

Automatic backups still need a backup password. Existing installs keep all their templates, clients, people and settings.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.17 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.17.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
